test_date_offset_by: test the date offset_by method with string offsets like 1d, -1d, 3d, 72h, and -2mo on date series
test_datetime_offset_by: test the datetime offset_by method across time units ms, us, ns and time zones Europe/London, Asia/Kathmandu, and UTC
test_offset_by_unique_29_feb_19608: test offset_by with leap year dates by shifting 2020 dates back one year and deduplicating

test_offset_by_unequal_length_22018: test that offset_by raises a ShapeError when the offset series has a different length than the input series
